title: HeyGen avatar — maintenance advisory
promptText:
Write a ready-to-paste HeyGen avatar script for a 25–35 second MahaTransco public advisory video.

Spoken script (use this wording unless a fact is missing):
"Namaskar. This is a short public advisory from MahaTransco. Planned maintenance may affect power supply in selected areas tonight between 10 PM and 2 AM. Please plan essential activities accordingly. For updates, check official MahaTransco channels only. Do not rely on forwarded WhatsApp messages. Thank you."

Also provide:
1. On-screen captions broken into 4 short lines
2. Avatar direction: formal Indian official attire, neutral studio background, steady eye contact, moderate pace
3. Language note: primary English; offer a Marathi twin script with the same facts
4. Mandatory end-card text: "AI-generated presenter — verify on official MahaTransco channels"
5. Do-not-list: no fake logos, no invented phone numbers, no maps with wrong circles

Output as sections: Spoken EN | Spoken MR | Captions | Production notes.
